identity.basisReason: Dry per-100g basis matches how packaged oats are labeled and avoids cooked-water dilution.

scoreReadiness.summary: Identity, basis, macros, fibre, starch, and core micronutrients are solid enough to use. Grain scoring still needs a locked GI policy for dry oats versus prepared oats.
blockers: glycemic_index intentionally withheld because it is preparation-dependent

sourceNotes: Identity locked to plain rolled oats, dry, per 100 g as sold.
Core nutrient values align with common USDA FoodData Central style entries for dry oats/rolled oats.
Weak proxy metrics were removed rather than preserved as fake certainty.

topPros.title: contains meaningful beta-glucan soluble fibre
topPros.explanation: Oats are unusual among common grains for their beta-glucan content, which makes the fibre story more specific than just the fibre grams already shown.

topPros.title: easy whole-grain staple to use regularly
topPros.explanation: Plain rolled oats are cheap, familiar, and realistic for repeated use, which matters for an everyday grain.

topPros.title: plain oats start unsweetened
topPros.explanation: That gives them a cleaner baseline than sweetened instant oatmeal products, which are excluded from this entry.

topCons.title: phytates can modestly reduce mineral uptake
topCons.explanation: That caveat is real for oats, even if it does not erase their mineral content.

topCons.title: the bowl can get worse fast with sugary add-ons
topCons.explanation: The plain ingredient is solid, but common preparation choices can change the real meal a lot.

topCons.title: texture and tolerance are not universal wins
topCons.explanation: Some people dislike the texture or do not tolerate oats especially well, which is a real usability downside for a staple food.

explanation.summary: Proteins are carrying this food most, while vitamins are holding it back most. It lands in S tier.
explanation.whyThisTier: This food lands in S tier with an overall score of 81.8. Section scores: fats 60, carbs 77.5, proteins 100, vitamins 25, minerals 28, pros 66.7, cons 50.
